info.title: ResearchTools remarks planning
info.description: Plans spoken remarks against a declared time slot from a BRIEF Map: word budget, clock marks, pace warnings, drafted script or answer cards, placement and fact checks, written-submission skeleton. Service callers are non-persistent. budget and check modes call no model and are deterministic. Discover support before submitting; omission of remarksPlanning means unavailable.

get.description: Require identityType=service, capabilities.remarksPlanning=true, contractVersions.remarksPlanning=remarks-plan.v1 and the community.research.execute scope. Omission means unavailable. Limits advertised: remarksRequestBytes, remarksScriptChars, remarksBranchItems, remarksVoiceChars.

200.description: Integration discovery; additive capabilities and versions may be present.

post.description: Requires enabled community integrations, REMARKS_SERVICE_ENABLED, and community.research.execute. Request <=32 KiB UTF-8; script <=6000 chars; voice <=2000 chars; <=12 items per map branch. Nothing is truncated: over a limit is a refusal naming the limit. mode=budget needs venue only and calls no model; mode=check needs venue+script and calls no model; mode=script needs venue+map; mode=trim needs venue+map+script. A trim whose output fails the fact guard or ask placement is 502 upstream_invalid_response and the caller's script is untouched. saveToFramework=true from a service credential is 400. Rate is derived from a preset or a measured read; a bare wpm is rejected.

200.description: Budget, warnings and (per mode) script or answer cards, counts, placement, fact guard, written submission. Cache-Control: no-store.

429.description: Middleware rate limit; flat error, not integration-error.v1. Metered as service:<clientId>. Do not retry in a loop.

serviceBearer.description: Keep server-side. Never in a browser, extension, or static page.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-ID
CorrelationId.description: Optional caller correlation; echoed in discovery, in every error, and in the plan response.

ServiceError.description: Nested integration-error.v1. Codes: 400/413 invalid_request; 401 authentication_required/invalid_service_token/expired_service_token; 403 scope_denied; 405 method_not_allowed; 500 internal_error; 502 upstream_invalid_response (retry once). Bodies never echo the map, script, or voice.

Unavailable.description: 503 auth_datastore_unavailable, or flat middleware error with retryable=true; Retry-After: 2.
